# formal-kani-tiers.txt : which Kani harnesses run on the hosted runners (4 vCPU, 16 GB, 6 h per job).
#   <tier> <kani-crate dir> <harness regex (matched against the fully qualified name)>  <reason>
# tier exclude : never scheduled here (does not fit; runs on a bigger machine)
# tier probe   : scheduled only by a manual run with kani_probe=true, result not gating (fit unknown / being measured)
# tier broken  : (crate) a compile failure of this harness crate is reported as a warning, not a failure; retried on every run
# Every other listed harness is REQUIRED: it must report VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL within the job limit.
exclude kani-rust-pca decision_logic_abstract$        did not finish in 8 h 23 m (CaDiCaL) / 4 h 57 m (kissat, 16 vCPU)
exclude kani-rust-pca json_abs_pcactn_shape$          did not finish in 8 h 17 m / 3 h 05 m on 16 vCPU
exclude kani-rust-pca b64u_wrapper_contract_le64$     about 4 h 50 m on 16 vCPU; over 6 h expected on 4 vCPU
probe   kani-rust-pca json_field1_                    bounded-2 variants ran out of memory at 12 GB
probe   kani-rust-pca ::d_                            decomposed decision harnesses: symbolic execution > 60 min, B-tree unwinding
probe   kani-rust-pca decode_b64u_no_panic_bounded$   lengths 4..7 ran out of memory at 12 GB
probe   kani-rust-pca decision_aggregation$           monolithic decision harness (same B-tree loops)
probe   kani-zkvm-core zk_decode_b64u_strict_bounded6$  exhausted the 16 GB runner after 13 min
